name: incremental_ingestion_reference
description: Reference-only ADF-style configuration showing a watermark-based incremental ingestion flow.

activities.name: LookupLastWatermark
activities.purpose: Read the last successfully committed watermark from pipeline metadata

activities.name: CopyIncrementalRows
activities.source_query_template: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE updated_at > :last_watermark AND updated_at <= :current_watermark

activities.name: ValidateRowCounts
activities.purpose: Compare expected and landed row counts before committing the checkpoint

activities.name: CommitWatermark
activities.purpose: Advance the watermark only after all ingestion checks succeed

notes: This file is a portfolio reference and is not intended to be imported directly into ADF.
Secrets and connection strings must be resolved through Key Vault or managed identity rather than embedded in source control.
